title: PebbleMeet
author: Alex Palson
description:
PebbleMeet turns your Pebble smartwatch into a tactile Google Meet hardware controller—with zero local server and zero Google OAuth setup required.

Features:
- Instant 6-character pairing code bridge between Pebble and Chrome (works over Wi-Fi, VPN, and cellular)
- One-press New Google Meet launcher and live sync of open Meet tabs
- Quick Contacts: start a Meet room and automatically invite/ring contacts, or invite them into your current call
- Physical ActionBar controls: instant Mute/Push-to-Talk (UP), Toggle PTT / Long-press End Call (SELECT), Camera On/Off (DOWN)
- Raise/Lower Hand, Live Captions (CC) ticker, and Pebble Mic Dictation chat
- Active call pinned first when browsing back to the menu, with call-switch & hang-up confirmation
- Dismissible watch alerts (Lobby knocks with SELECT to admit, Chat previews, Recording notices)
- Optional private Calendar (.ics) feed support with wrap-up reminders
- Native layouts for Pebble Classic (Aplite), Pebble Time (Basalt), Pebble Time Round (Chalk), Pebble 2 (Diorite), and Pebble Time 2 (Emery)

Companion Chrome Bridge & source code: https://github.com/senorsunday/pebble-meet-watchapp
releaseNotes: v0.2.0: Cloudflare Durable Objects Phone <-> Chrome bridge with 6-char pairing code, automated contact inviting/ringing in Google Meet, zero-OAuth Quick Contacts & optional .ics calendar feed, conflict-free PTT button defaults (fixes Issue #1), hang-up confirmation, live captions ticker, and battery/AppMessage reliability fixes.
